description:
Solves processes and whole cycles with CoolProp, written as a Thermoprops Worksheet script. Answers a table of the states, the printed results, errors by line, and a link that opens it solved with diagrams: give it to the user.

One statement per line, # comments:
fluid R134a
units celsius             # or kelvin, imperial
reference ASHRAE          # zero of h, s: DEF, ASHRAE (textbook refrigerant tables), IIR, NBP
1: T = -10 °C, sat vapor  # two properties; sat liquid is x = 0
2: from 1, compressed to P = 1.2 MPa, eta = 80%
3: P = P2, sat liquid
4: from 3, throttled to P = P1
COP = (h1 - h4) / (h2 - h1)
print COP, T2 in °F, cp2
Processes: isentropic, compressed/expanded (eta), throttled, isobaric, isothermal, isochoric, isenthalpic, polytropic (n).
Properties: T P h s x D v u cp cv mu k Pr Z a g; states show T P h s x v, print others.
Fluids: Air, Ammonia, Argon, CarbonDioxide, CarbonMonoxide, Ethanol, Helium, Hydrogen, IsoButane, Isopentane, Methane, n-Butane, n-Pentane, n-Propane, Nitrogen, Oxygen, R1234yf, R1234ze(E), R125, R134a, R143a, R152A, R22, R245fa, R32, R404A, R410A, R507A, Toluene, Water.
More syntax: language_reference.
